text:
Jordan (MapleDocs): Hey team — we started seeing consistent 429s hitting our integration. Looks like they spike exactly at the top of every minute for the last 2 hours.
Priya (Support): Sorry you're hitting that — can you paste a sample request id or a curl and any headers you see?
Jordan (MapleDocs): Sure. Example response header from our logs: 
```
x-rw-ratelimit-limit: 1200
x-rw-ratelimit-remaining: 0
x-rw-ratelimit-reset: 23
x-request-id: rq_01E23F456
status: 429
body: {"error":"rate_exceeded","message":"RPM limit hit"}
```
Priya (Support): thanks. Do you have many workers firing simultaneously?
Jordan (MapleDocs): We run a cronjob that fans out ~150 short-lived pods. The job triggers at `0 * * * *` and each worker makes ~20 requests right away.
Dylan (Platform): that pattern will create a top-of-minute sync. 150 pods * 20 req = 3k requests at :00 — exceeds per-key RPM. Looks like no client-side jitter/backoff.
Tina (Support-Eng): @Jordan can you share the CronJob spec or the entrypoint script? Also which API key are you using (prod vs integration)?
Jordan (MapleDocs): using prod key. CronJob snippet: 
```
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: doc-sync
spec:
  schedule: "0 * * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: sync
            image: maple/sync:latest
            args: ["/bin/sync-run"]
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          concurrencyPolicy: Allow
```
No jitter in sync-run.
Priya (Support): Two quick mitigation options: 1) temporary burst increase on your project so requests won't get 429s while you change client, 2) add jitter/randomized sleep to the job to spread load across the minute.
Dylan (Platform): Also consider switching to pooled persistent workers rather than spawning many short-lived pods, or have the job enqueue work and let a fixed-size worker pool drain it with rate-limited dispatch.
Jordan (MapleDocs): Can we get a short-term uplift? We need time to roll a fix.
Tina (Support-Eng): I can open a support escalation for a 10-minute burst window and raise RPM to 10k for 30 minutes while you deploy. Send me the account id and the key prefix.
Jordan (MapleDocs): account_id: acct_maple_44, key prefix: pk_live_maple_zz
ops-bot: Alert: rate_cap_event for acct_maple_44 registered at 2026-03-17T14:00:12Z, 429 count: 1875 in last 60s.
Tina (Support-Eng): Uplift request submitted. Change should be live in ~2 min. Please still prepare a client fix.
Jordan (MapleDocs): Thanks — rolling a canary with a randomized pre-start sleep: `sleep $((RANDOM % 60))` in entrypoint, pushing now.
Priya (Support): Nice quick fix. Also add exponential backoff+jitter on retries (avoid tight retry loops on 429).
Dylan (Platform): For diagnostic data, you can run this against logs to see per-minute counts: 
```
jq -r '.timestamp|floor/60 as $m | "minute="+$m|" req_id="+.request_id' logs.json | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head
```
Jordan (MapleDocs): Canary applied, pods now spread across the minute. Seeing 429s drop to near zero after the jitter landed. :thumbsup:
Tina (Support-Eng): Great. Keep an eye on the dashboard for a couple hours. We'll let the temporary uplift expire.
Jordan (MapleDocs): Will do. Action items: 1) keep CronJob jitter in prod entrypoint (deployed) 2) consider worker pool refactor (planning ticket) 3) add client-side retry jitter.
Priya (Support): Closing the immediate support loop — ping if any regression. If you want, we can schedule a follow-up review with Platform to recommend long-term architecture changes.
Jordan (MapleDocs): Appreciate it, thanks everyone.
Tina (Support-Eng): Marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
